metadata.title: Vehicle Communication Protocol & Occupant-Classification Database
metadata.description: Maps car make / model / year-range to the diagnostic/communication protocol they use, and records the message IDs and signal values relevant to passenger-airbag / occupant-classification (OCS) conversion. Built for the FjCruiserPassangerAirbagConverter project.

confidenceLegend.project: Taken directly from this repository's source (config.h / k_line.h). Authoritative for this build.
confidenceLegend.standard: Defined by a public standard (SAE J1979 / ISO 15765-4 / ISO 9141-2). High confidence.
confidenceLegend.documented: From a publicly available service/repair manual or DTC reference. High confidence.
confidenceLegend.inferred: Reasoned from make/model/year and protocol transition timelines. Verify on the vehicle before relying on it.
confidenceLegend.unknown: Not publicly documented. Reverse-engineering on the specific vehicle required. Value left null.

notes: Bus-level diagnostic protocol (how a scan tool talks to the powertrain over the OBD-II port) is distinct from the in-car module bus that actually carries occupant/airbag data. Both are recorded where known.

Many 2004-2008 vehicles are 'hybrid': CAN (ISO 15765-4) for emissions/powertrain at the OBD-II port, but a legacy K-line (ISO 9141-2 / ISO 14230) retained for body modules such as the airbag/OCS ECU. The FJ Cruiser is one of these.

Occupant-classification frame IDs and byte encodings are vehicle-specific and almost never published. Only the FJ Cruiser values here come from this project; other vehicles list standard diagnostic addressing and leave proprietary OCS frame details null.
sources: 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser Repair Manual - Supplemental Restraint System / Occupant Classification System (purefjcruiser.com)
OBD2 protocols by vehicle make and model (obdplanet.com, obdtester.com)

iso9141-2.name: ISO 9141-2
iso9141-2.physicalLayer: Single-wire, 12V-referenced (logic-level shifter such as MC33290 required for an MCU)
iso9141-2.typicalRegion: Older European & Asian vehicles, and Asian-built body modules

iso15765-4-can-11-500.name: ISO 15765-4 CAN (11-bit, 500 kbps)
iso15765-4-can-11-500.typicalRegion: Most vehicles 2008+ (mandatory in North America from 2008)

signalCatalog.description: Canonical occupant-classification signals this project cares about, independent of vehicle. Per-vehicle entries reference these by key and supply the actual IDs/encodings where known.

seatbelt_status.meaning: Front passenger seat belt buckle state

passenger_classification.meaning: Occupant weight category used to gate the passenger airbag and seatbelt chime

behavior.child: Passenger airbag OFF/suppressed, chime suppressed (occupant under ~30 kg)
behavior.adult: Passenger airbag ON, chime active (occupant over ~30 kg threshold)

airbag_indicator.meaning: PASSENGER AIRBAG ON/OFF indicator lamp request

vehicles.diagnosticNote: OBD-II port is CAN (ISO 15765-4) for 5-digit DTC reading via DLC3. The Occupant Classification ECU itself is reached over a legacy K-line / serial diagnostic (DIA line) - this is the bus this project taps.

occupantClassification.method: 4 weight sensors at the seat corners + seat-belt buckle switch
occupantClassification.moduleBusNote: Single-line 'DIA' communication between the OCS ECU and airbag sensor assembly, aligned with ISO 9141-2. Interfaced via MC33290 + OBD9141 library in this project.

signals.note: ID defined in src/config.h. Payload byte layout not yet decoded in this repo.
ID defined in src/config.h. Payload byte layout not yet decoded in this repo.

dtcs.meaning: Front passenger occupant sensor / wiring fault
Front passenger occupant sensor / wiring fault
Front passenger occupant sensor / wiring fault

occupantClassification.calibration: Zero-point calibration required whenever the passenger seat is removed/installed or items are added to it (hand-held tester via DLC3).

vehicles.diagnosticNote: Donor seats for this project. Pre-2008 S197s used Ford's J1850 PWM at the OBD-II port for powertrain; body/restraint modules communicate over the internal MS-CAN/HS-CAN network.

occupantClassification.ecu: Restraint Control Module (RCM) + passenger occupant classification sensor
occupantClassification.method: Seat weight / occupant sensor with CAN-reported buckle and occupant status
occupantClassification.moduleBusNote: This project reads the seat's CAN output to derive buckled / child / adult state. Use CanHandler::process or a Canable+CANgaroo capture to discover the actual frame IDs on a given seat harness.

signals.note: Frame ID and byte layout must be captured per seat harness; not publicly documented. This project maps the captured states onto empty/child/adult.
